When a block (the 4th or later) has the smallest range of the day so far and under 80% of the earlier blocks' average, watch the next half hour: the first close above that block's high while above VWAP leans long, the first close below its low while under VWAP leans short. Nothing after 14:30 ET. One signal per session; tested with and against.
- **nr4_ib_break** (volatility, M5): Yesterday's range was the narrowest of the last four sessions. The first 5-minute close from 10:30 to 12:55 beyond today's initial balance high (low) is the signal; one per session; tested with and against.
- **range_expansion_vwap_pullback** (volatility, M5): When the day's range has already reached 70% of the 10-day average daily range by 11:00 ET, the side of VWAP price is on sets the day's direction. The first bar that touches VWAP and closes back on the trend side signals with the trend (tested with and against). One signal per session, until 14:30 ET.
- **rvi_dorsey_cross** (volatility, M5): The Relative Volatility Index measures whether the recent size of price swings (10-bar standard deviation of closes) is coming on up bars or down bars, smoothed over 14 bars and scaled 0-100. Between 10:30 and 14:30 the first cross up through 50 while price is above VWAP leans long, the first cross down through 50 while price is below VWAP leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.
- **renko_reversal_confirm** (volatility, M5): Renko bricks of half the opening 5-minute ATR are built from 5-minute closes (a reversal needs two bricks). When a run that began with a reversal gets its second brick, and the close is on the same side of VWAP, between 10:00 and 15:00 ET, the setup leans with the new run; at most two a session. Tested with and against.
- **starc_band_reversal** (volatility, M5): Bands sit 2 ATR above and below the 6-bar average close. A 5-minute bar that pokes through the upper band but closes back inside leans short (the mirror at the lower band leans long), between 10:00 and 14:30, if the previous bar did not also tag that band. At most two signals per session; tested with and against.
- **ttm_squeeze_fire** (volatility, M5): Bollinger(20,2) bands sit entirely inside Keltner(20 EMA, 1.5 x ATR20) for at least 6 five-minute bars. On the first bar they leave the channel, lean the way the momentum reading points (close vs the midpoint of the 20-bar range and SMA20), before 15:00. Tested with and against.
- **d_turn_of_month** (seasonal (daily), D): Buy the close of the second-to-last trading day of each month and hold per the lab's exit; no other condition.
- **turnaround_tuesday** (seasonal (daily), D): When a Monday closes at least 1% below the previous trading day's close, lean long at the next open (Tuesday). One signal per qualifying Monday.
- **vr_vwap_fade** (volatility, M5): Between 12:00 and 14:30, when the variance ratio of the last 30 five-minute returns at a 4-bar horizon is below 0.8 (price has been mean-reverting rather than trending), a bar that closed beyond VWAP +/- 1.5 standard deviations and is followed by a bar closing back inside the band leans back toward VWAP (stretched high: short). One signal per side per session; tested with and against.
- **wide_range_bar** (volatility, M5): Between 10:00 and 14:30, the first 5-minute bar whose high-to-low range is at least 2x the usual 5-minute ATR and that closes in the top (or bottom) fifth of its range leans with that direction. One per day.
- **williams_green_bar** (volatility, M5): A 5-minute bar where volume and range-per-volume (Williams' Market Facilitation Index) both rise versus the previous bar, body at least 60% of range, relative volume at least 1.2, closing beyond the prior six bars' high (or low), 10:00 to 14:30 ET, at most two a session. Leans with the bar. Tested with and against.
- **williams_vix_fix** (volatility, M5): Measure how far the 5-minute low has fallen below the highest close of the last 22 bars (Larry Williams' VIX Fix). When that drop jumps above its own Bollinger band (20 bars, 2 sd) or above 85% of its 50-bar high, the selling looks like a capitulation low: lean long; the mirror (high far above the lowest close of 22 bars) leans short. One signal per side per session, only after about 13:00 ET when enough bars exist; tested with and against.
- **adl_range_break** (volume, M5): The running Accumulation/Distribution line closes above its prior 20-bar maximum (or below its minimum) while the bar closes on the same side of session VWAP and price has not yet broken its own prior 20-bar high (or low). 10:15 to 14:30 ET, at most two a session. Leans with the money flow. Tested with and against.
- **afternoon_vwap_trend_pullback** (vwap, M5): If at least 80% of the 5-minute closes before 13:00 sit on one side of VWAP, the first bar between 13:00 and 15:30 that touches VWAP and still closes on the trend side leans with the day. Tested with and against; one signal per session.
- **amihud_impact_spike** (volume, M5): A bar between 10:00 and 15:00 ET whose body moved at least 3x as far per share traded as the average of the previous 20 bars, and whose body is at least 0.8 ATR. Signal on its close in the body's direction; one per side per session; tested with and against.
- **anchored_vwap** (vwap, M5): From 10:30 to 14:30, VWAP anchored at the session's low (or high) so far, at least 8 bars old. After 3 bars closing on the anchor's side of it, a bar that wicks to the anchored VWAP and closes back on that side in that direction leans away from the anchor. One signal per side per session.
- **balance_area_break** (volume profile, M5): If yesterday's and the day before's 70% value areas overlap by at least 70% of the narrower one, the first 5-minute close after the initial balance (first hour) and before 14:00 beyond the outer edge of the two value areas leans in the break direction. Tested with and against; one signal per session.
- **chaikin_oscillator_cross** (volume, M5): The Chaikin Oscillator (3-bar EMA minus 10-bar EMA of the session's accumulation/distribution line) crossing above zero while price closes above VWAP leans long; crossing below zero while price closes below VWAP leans short. After the first 12 bars, before 15:00 ET, at most two a session; tested with and against.
- **clv_delta_divergence** (volume, M5): Add up each 5-minute bar's volume weighted by where it closed in its range (top = all buying, bottom = all selling). A new session high (low) at least 8 bars after the last one, with that running total below (above) where it stood at the earlier extreme, and a bar closing against the extreme, leans against the extreme (fade) or with it, both tested. One per side per session, 10:30 to 14:30.
- **cmf_zero_cross_vwap** (volume, M5): Chaikin Money Flow over the last 20 five-minute bars of the session crosses from at or below zero to +0.05 or more while price closes above VWAP leans long; from at or above zero to -0.05 or less while price closes below VWAP leans short, before 15:00. Tested with and against.
- **cumvol_ib_break** (volume, M5): The first close beyond the initial-balance high (long) or low (short) between 10:30 and 13:00 ET, counted only if the session's cumulative volume so far is at least 1.5x the average cumulative volume at the same bar over the previous 10 sessions. One signal per side per session; tested with and against.
- **developing_poc_retest** (Volume profile, M5): Build the day's volume profile as it stands bar by bar. After price has closed at least 1.5 ATR away from the developing point of control, the first return to it (within 0.05 ATR) that closes back on the side price came from, in that direction, is the signal. 10:30 to 14:30, one a session.
- **developing_va_reentry** (volume profile, M5): After 11:00, when a close beyond the session's developing value-area high (low) by 0.1 ATR is followed by a close back inside it, lean toward the developing POC (short from above, long from below), before 14:30.
- **double_distribution_neck** (volume profile, M5): From 12:00 to 14:00, if the session's volume profile shows two separate fat regions at least 1.5 ATR apart (each at least 60% of the heaviest price) joined by a thin neck (under 35% of the smaller region), the first close at least 0.25 ATR above (below) the neck marks which distribution price has settled in. One signal per session; tested with and against.
- **emv_cross_vwap** (volume, M5): Arms' Ease of Movement (midpoint change per unit of relative volume, 14-bar average, restarted each session) crosses zero between 10:00 and 14:30 while price closes on the same side of VWAP: up-cross above VWAP leans long, down-cross below VWAP leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.
- **er_vwap_2sd** (volume, M5): Between 11:00 and 14:30 ET, when Kaufman's Efficiency Ratio over the last 20 closes (net move divided by the sum of bar-to-bar moves) is below 0.25, a bar that closes 2 or more VWAP standard deviations below VWAP signals a long back toward VWAP, and 2 or more above signals a short. One signal per side per session. Tested with and against; the stretch is only read when the tape has been going nowhere.
- **excess_tail_retest** (volume profile, M5): Yesterday's profile (5 bps bins): if the session high (low) has a tail, meaning at least two consecutive bins from the extreme down (up) that only one 5-minute bar touched, it is an excess extreme. Today, the first bar before 14:00 that trades within 0.05 ATR of that extreme or beyond it but closes back on the inside leans away from it (short at an excess high, long at an excess low). Cancelled for that side if a bar closes beyond the extreme first. Tested with and against; up to one signal per side per session.
- **first_vwap_pullback_lowvol** (vwap, M5): After at least six 5-minute closes on one side of VWAP, the first bar to touch VWAP (or close within 0.1% of it) on lighter average volume than the run, closing back on the trend side in a trend-direction candle, leans with the run. 10:00 to 14:30, one per side per session; tested with and against.
- **force_index_zero_cross** (volume, M5): Elder's Force Index (close change times volume, 13-bar EMA, restarted each session) crosses through zero between 10:00 and 14:30 while price closes on the same side of VWAP: up-cross above VWAP leans long, down-cross below VWAP leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.
- **heavy_volume_morning_trend** (volume, M5): When the first hour (9:30-10:30) trades at 1.5x or more of its usual volume, and price at 10:30 is at least 0.5 ATR beyond the open and on the same side of VWAP, lean with that direction. One trade per session.
- **hvb_midpoint_retest** (volume, M5): After 10:00, a bar with at least 3x the session's average bar volume, a range of at least 1 ATR and a close in its top (bottom) 30% marks a level. The first later bar before 14:30 that trades back to the bar's midpoint (within 0.1 ATR) and closes on the bar's side leans long (short). Abandoned if price closes beyond the far end of the bar. One signal per session.
- **ib_break_delta_confirm** (volume, M5): Between 10:35 and 14:30, the first bar that closes beyond the initial-balance high (low) while the session's cumulative volume-weighted close-location delta and the last 6 bars' delta are both positive (negative) leans long (short) with the break. One signal per side per session.
- **ib_inside_value_break** (volume profile, M5): When the first hour's high and low both sit inside yesterday's 70% value area, the first 5-minute close beyond the initial balance (before 14:00) leans in the break direction. Tested with and against; one signal per session.
- **ib_volume_share_break** (volume profile, M5): If the first hour's volume was at least 25% of yesterday's full-day volume, the first 5-minute close beyond the initial balance (first hour) before 14:00 leans in the break direction. Tested with and against; one signal per session.
- **ib_vwap_side_break** (volume profile, M5): The first 5-minute close beyond the initial balance (before 14:00) counts only if session VWAP is above the IB midpoint for an upside break, or below it for a downside break. One signal per session; a first break against the VWAP lean is skipped. Tested with and against.
- **intensity_bb** (volume, M5): Intraday Intensity weighs each 5-minute bar's volume by where it closed in its range and sums the last 21 bars. Between 10:30 and 15:00, if price closes at or below the lower Bollinger band while that buying/selling pressure reading is still positive, it leans long (a reversion); at or above the upper band with a negative reading it leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.
- **ivb_anchored_vwap** (volume/vwap, M5): VWAP anchored at the heaviest 5-minute bar of the first 30 minutes. From 10:00 to 14:30, after 3 closes at least 0.1 ATR on one side of it, a bar that wicks to it (within 0.1 ATR) and closes back on that side leans away from it; one per side per session.
- **ivb_failed_break** (volume, M5): After the first 30 minutes, the heaviest 5-minute bar defines the initial volume bar. A close beyond its high or low that is taken back inside its range within 3 bars is a failed break; the close back inside leans against the break, 10:00 to 14:00. One signal per session.
- **kalman_vwap_cross** (volume, M5): A local-level Kalman filter (noise ratio 0.15, restarted each session) of the 5-minute typical price crosses session VWAP from below (above) and the bar closes on the same side of the Kalman line, between 10:00 and 14:30. One signal per side per session; tested with and against.
- **klinger_signal_cross** (volume, M5): The Klinger Volume Oscillator (standard 34/55/13, restarted each session) crosses its signal line between 11:00 and 14:30 while price closes on the same side of VWAP: up-cross above VWAP leans long, down-cross below VWAP leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.
- **lod_anchored_vwap_retest** (volume / VWAP, M5): Anchor a VWAP at the day's running low (high). Once price has closed at least 1.5 ATR away from it, the first bar between 10:00 and 15:00 ET that dips to the anchored VWAP and closes back on the trend side (up bar for a long, down bar for a short) is the signal. One per side per day. Tested with and against.
- **lunch_drift_vwap_revert** (vwap, M5): If the 11:30-13:30 lunch hours trade at under 80% of their usual volume and price at 13:30 sits at least 1 ATR away from VWAP, the drift lacks participation, so lean back toward VWAP. One trade per session. Tested with and against.
- **mfi_extreme_cross** (volume, M5): The 14-bar Money Flow Index (typical price x volume, up-bars versus down-bars) climbs back above 20 while price closes at least 1 volume-weighted standard deviation below VWAP (leans long), or falls back below 80 while price closes at least 1 above VWAP (leans short), between 10:45 and 14:30. One per side per session. Tested with and against, like every setup.
- **morning_flow_fade** (volume, M5): By 10:30 price is at least 0.5 ATR from the open, but the 10:00-10:30 half hour traded under 60% of the 9:30-10:00 volume: the push is losing participation, so the move leans back against the morning direction. One trade per session. Tested with and against.
- **naked_poc_touch** (volume profile, M5): A prior session's point of control that no later session has traded through is a naked POC. When today's price first reaches the most recent one (at least one ATR from the open) between 10:00 and 15:00, the setup leans in the direction of travel into it; tested with and against (fade). One signal per session.
- **narrow_va_ib_break** (volume profile, M5): If yesterday's 70% value area (VAH-VAL) was no wider than 0.30% of yesterday's close, the first 5-minute close beyond today's initial balance (first hour) before 14:00 leans in the break direction. Tested with and against; one signal per session.
- **nvi_ema_cross** (volume, M5): A Negative Volume Index built from the session's 5-minute bars (it moves with price only on bars whose volume is lower than the bar before) crosses above or below its 20-bar average between 11:00 and 14:30 while price closes on the same side of VWAP: up-cross above VWAP leans long, down-cross below VWAP leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.
- **obv_divergence_extreme** (volume, M5): A new session low whose on-balance volume (restarted each session) is higher than at the previous session low, 6+ bars earlier, and that closes as an up bar leans long; a new session high with lower OBV than at the previous high that closes as a down bar leans short. 10:30-14:30 ET, one signal per session; tested with and against.
- **otf_loss** (volume, M5): After six straight bars that each make a higher high and higher low (or lower high and lower low), the first bar closing through the prior bar's far end shows the controlling side has stopped; lean against the old run. After 10:00, before 15:00, at most two per session.
- **open_outside_value_retest** (volume profile, M5): The session opens above yesterday's value area high (or below the value area low). The first bar before 14:00 that wicks back to that level and closes beyond it again leans with the opening direction; cancelled if a bar closes back through the level first. Once per session, tested with and against.
- **or_poc_retest** (volume, M5): Take the volume profile of the first 30 minutes and its point of control. After price closes beyond the 30-minute high (low), a later bar before 14:00 ET that dips (pokes) back to the opening-range POC and closes back above (below) it on a candle in the breakout direction signals a long (short). One signal per side per session. Tested with and against.
- **orb_vwap_slope** (opening range, M5): First 5-minute close beyond the 15-minute opening range, before 11:00, counts only if session VWAP has moved the same way by at least 0.05 ATR over the last 3 bars and the close is on that side of VWAP; one signal per session. Tested with and against, like every setup.
- **d_pocket_pivot** (volume (daily), D): A daily close above the prior close, on volume greater than every down day's volume in the prior 10 sessions, with the close above its 10-day average, is a pocket pivot (institutional buying outweighing recent selling). The mirror image (down day, volume above every prior-10 up day, close below the 10-day average) is the bearish version.
- **power_hour_range_break** (session time, M5): Mark the 14:00-15:00 ET range. If it is at most a third of the day's range so far, the first 5-minute close beyond it between 15:00 and 15:40 on at least 1.2x normal volume leans with the break. Tested with and against.
- **prior_close_cross** (volume, M5): The first hour (initial balance) trades entirely below (or above) yesterday's close. The first 5-minute bar before 14:00 ET that closes through yesterday's close on 1.5x normal volume leans with the cross: long through it from below, short through it from above.
- **prior_day_volume_climax** (volume, M5): When yesterday's volume was at least 1.5x the average of the ten sessions before it and it closed in the top (bottom) fifth of its range, and at the 10:30 close price is above (below) VWAP, mark that direction. Tested with and against; one signal per session.
- **prior_hvn_secondary** (volume profile, M5): Yesterday's profile (5 bps bins): a second peak at least 6 bins from the POC, with at least 70% of the POC's bin volume and the highest volume within 2 bins either side, is the secondary HVN. Today, price trades on one side; the first bar before 14:00 that wicks to the HVN but closes back on the approach side leans in the approach direction. Tested with and against; one signal per session, cancelled if a bar closes through the HVN first.
- **prior_lvn_rejection** (volume profile, M5): Yesterday's profile (5 bps bins): the lowest-volume bin inside the value area, at least 3 bins from the POC and at most 60% of the value area's mean bin volume, is the LVN. Today, price trades on one side; the first bar before 14:00 that wicks to the LVN but closes back on the approach side leans in the approach direction. Tested with and against; one signal per session, cancelled if a bar closes through the LVN first.
- **prior_peak_bar_hold** (volume profile, M5): Take yesterday's single highest-volume 5-minute bar. Between 09:45 and 13:55 ET, the first time price comes down from above and dips to the bar's high but closes back above it, it leans long; the first time it comes up from below to the bar's low and closes back under, it leans short. Skipped when the bar is narrower than 0.3 ATR. One signal per session; tested with and against.
- **prior_poc_rejection** (volume profile, M5): Price trades on one side of yesterday's POC; the first bar that wicks to the POC but closes back on the approach side, before 14:00, leans in the direction of the approach. Tested with and against; one signal per session, cancelled if a bar closes through the POC first.
- **prior_vwap_band_break** (volume profile, M5): Yesterday's session VWAP plus and minus one volume-weighted standard deviation is treated as value. The first bar between 10:00 and 14:30 that closes outside the band (previous bar inside) on at least 1.2x its usual volume for that time of day leans in the break direction. Once per session, tested with and against.
- **profile_skew_1100** (volume profile, M5): At the first 5-minute close at or after 11:00 ET, build the volume profile of the session so far. If its POC sits in the top third of the day's range so far (p-shape) the setup leans long; in the bottom third (b-shape) it leans short. Skipped when the range so far is under 1.5 ATR. Tested with and against; one signal per session.
- **pvi_nvi_joint** (volume, M5): Two volume-split price indexes are built from the session's 5-minute bars: PVI moves with price only on bars with more volume than the bar before (the crowd), NVI only on bars with less (the quiet money). When both move above their own 20-bar averages between 11:00 and 14:30 while price closes above VWAP, it leans long; both below with price under VWAP leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.
- **pvo_signal_cross** (volume, M5): The Percentage Volume Oscillator compares a fast (12-bar) and slow (26-bar) average of 5-minute volume; when it crosses above its 9-bar signal line, volume momentum is picking up. Between 10:30 and 14:30, if that bar also closes up and above VWAP it leans long; closing down and below VWAP leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.
- **pvt_divergence_extreme** (volume, M5): The session's Price Volume Trend (running sum of volume times each 5-minute bar's % price change) fails to confirm a new session closing high (it sits below its value at the previous high, which was at least 6 bars earlier) leans short; a new closing low on a PVT above its value at the previous low leans long. After 18 bars, before 14:30 ET, one signal a session; tested with and against.
- **extreme_avwap_reclaim** (volume, M5): Anchor a VWAP at the session's low (high), at least 8 bars old and still the extreme. When a bar closes up (down) through that anchored VWAP after the previous close was on the other side, that bar is the signal, between 10:00 and 14:30. Tested with and against; one signal per side per session.
- **single_print_fill** (volume profile, M5): Yesterday's widest price bin touched by only one 5-minute bar (a thin, fast passage) is the single-print zone. The first bar today that trades into it and closes back out the side it entered from leans WITH that close (continuation through the thin spot), before 15:00.
- **poor_high_low_break** (volume profile, M5): If yesterday's session high (low) bin was touched by more than one 5-minute bar, the auction didn't reject it cleanly (a poor high/low, unfinished business). The first close today beyond that poor high (low) leans WITH the break, before 15:00. A clean (single-touch) high/low is left untested by this setup.
- **thin_morning_extreme** (volume, M5): At 10:30 the close is in the top (bottom) 10% of the first-hour range, the range is at least one ATR, and first-hour volume is under 80% of yesterday's first hour. One signal per session; tested with and against.
- **twiggs_money_flow_cross** (volume, M5): Twiggs Money Flow (smoothed ratio of gap-aware accumulation/distribution volume to volume, 12-bar span) crossing above +0.05 while price closes above VWAP leans long; crossing below -0.05 while price closes below VWAP leans short. After the first 12 bars, before 15:00 ET, at most two a session; tested with and against.
- **two_day_composite_poc** (volume profile, M5): Build the volume profile of the last two sessions together and take its POC; skip the day when it sits within half an ATR of yesterday's own POC. Between 09:45 and 13:55 ET, when price approaches it from one side, the first bar that wicks to the level and closes back on the approach side leans in the direction of the approach. Cancelled if a bar closes through it first. One signal per session; tested with and against.
- **va_edge_flip_retest** (volume profile, M5): The session opens above yesterday's VAH (below yesterday's VAL). The first bar from the 4th bar to 14:00 whose low (high) comes within 0.1 ATR of that edge while it closes still outside value leans long (short): old value edge flips to support (resistance). Cancelled if any bar closes back inside value first. Tested with and against; one signal per session.
- **value_migration_trend** (volume profile, M5): Yesterday's POC, value area high and value area low are all higher (or all lower) than the session before's. At the 10:30 close, if price is on that side of yesterday's POC and of today's VWAP, lean with the migration. Once per session, tested with and against.
- **d_vol_confirmed_break** (volume (daily), D): A daily close above the prior 20-day high (below the 20-day low) on volume at least 1.5x the prior 50-day average, closing in the upper (lower) half of the day's range, leans with the break into the next session. Tested with and against.
- **volume_divergence_extreme** (volume, M5): A bar that makes a new session high (low) at least six bars after the previous extreme, on less than 60% of that earlier extreme bar's volume, and closes in the lower (upper) half of its range, between 10:30 and 14:30, leans against the push. Tested with and against; one signal per side per session.
- **volume_ramp_exhaustion** (volume, M5): Three bars in a row close in the same direction (each above its open and above the prior close) with volume rising on every bar, the third closing in the top (bottom) quarter of its range and more than 1.5 ATR beyond session VWAP, between 10:00 and 14:30 ET. One signal per side per session; signal is in the direction of the push, tested with and against.
- **volume_thrust** (volume, M5): A bar with at least 2.5x its usual volume for that time slot and a range of at least 1.5 ATR that breaks the session high (low) and closes in the top (bottom) 20% of its range leans with the thrust, between 10:00 and 14:30. One per side per session.
- **vpci_confirmation** (volume, M5): VPCI = (20-bar VWMA minus SMA) x (5-bar VWMA / SMA) x (5-bar volume / 20-bar volume), per session. When it crosses above zero, lean toward the side of the 20-bar average the close is on, if session VWAP agrees, 10:00 to 15:00 ET, at most two a session. Tested with and against.
- **vwap_1sd_hold** (volume, M5): After two consecutive 5-minute closes beyond the +1 SD VWAP band (or below -1 SD) within the last hour, the first bar that touches the band and closes back on the trend side leans with the trend, 10:00-14:30, once per side per session.
- **vwap_2sd_fading_volume** (VWAP, M5): A 5-minute bar whose high pierces VWAP +2 sigma (low pierces -2 sigma), closes against the stretch, on less volume than the average of the previous three bars, leans back toward VWAP. Up to two signals a session, 10:00 to 15:00.
- **vwap_band_walk** (volume, M5): Four 5-minute closes in a row beyond the +1 SD VWAP band (or below -1 SD), with VWAP sloping the same way over the last half hour, lean with the walk at the fourth close, 10:00-14:30, once per side per session.
- **vwap_bounce** (vwap, M5): After six bars closing on one side of VWAP with VWAP drifting at least 0.5 ATR that way, a bar that wicks to VWAP and closes back on the trend side in the trend direction leans with the trend. One signal per side per session, 10:00 to 14:30.
- **vwap_break_retest** (volume/vwap, M5): A 5-minute bar closing 0.4 ATR beyond VWAP right after a close on the other side is a break. The first bar 2 to 8 bars later that touches VWAP (within 0.1 ATR) and closes back on the break side leans in the break direction; one per side per session, 10:00 to 14:30.
- **vwap_chop_compression_break** (volume, M5): After at least four VWAP crosses since the open, when the last hour's range is no more than 60% of the initial balance, a 5-minute close beyond that hour's high (above VWAP) or low (below VWAP) between 11:30 and 14:30 leans with the break, once per session.
- **vwap_cross_range_fade** (volume/VWAP, M5): When price has crossed VWAP at least 4 times by 11:30 (a balanced, rotating day), the first bar between 11:35 and 14:30 that trades through the initial-balance high but closes back inside leans short; through the IB low but closes back inside leans long. One signal per session.
- **vwap_failed_reclaim** (vwap, M5): After six or more closes on one side of VWAP, price closes on the other side for only one or two bars, then closes back on the original side between 10:00 and 14:30. Lean toward the original side; tested with and against. One signal per session.
- **vwap_first_hour_hold** (vwap, M5): If all twelve 5-minute closes of the first hour sit on the same side of VWAP, the open is on that side, and the 10:30 close is at least 0.25 ATR away from VWAP, lean the same way. Tested with and against; one signal per session.
- **vwap_long_side_cross** (volume/VWAP, M5): When price has closed on one side of VWAP for at least 30 straight 5-minute bars (2.5 hours), the first close on the other side of VWAP between 12:05 and 14:30 ET signals in the direction of the cross (a trend day losing its anchor). One signal per session.
- **vwap_no_touch_noon** (vwap, M5): From 10:30 to 11:55 no 5-minute bar touches VWAP (all lows above it, or all highs below it) and the 11:55 close is at least 6 five-minute ATRs from the day's open on that side. Signal at the 11:55 close, one per session; tested with and against.
- **vwap_poc_confluence** (vwap, M5): After 10:30, when VWAP and the session's developing point of control are within 0.3 ATR of each other, a pullback that wicks into that zone and closes back on the side price came from, in that direction, leans with the bounce (and its fade is tested). One signal per side per session, to 14:30.
- **vwap_retest_prior_extreme** (vwap, M5): Once price has traded above yesterday's high and VWAP is above it too (mirror for lows), a bar after 10:00 that wicks to VWAP and closes back above it on an up bar leans long (down bar below VWAP leans short). One signal per side per session, before 12:30.
- **vwap_second_touch** (VWAP, M5): When the session has stayed on one side of VWAP since the first half hour and price touches VWAP for the second time (at least 4 bars after the first), closing back on the trend side in the trend's direction, lean with the trend. 10:30 to 14:30, one signal a session.
- **vwap_side_persistence** (vwap, M5): From 09:35 to the first bar at or after 11:00 ET, at least 90% of closes sit on one side of session VWAP and VWAP has moved the same way over the last 6 bars: lean with that side at the 11:00 close (long above, short below). One signal per session; tested with and against.
- **vwap_slope_turn** (vwap, M5): VWAP drifted one way from 10:30 to 11:30 (at least 0.5 ATR), then reversed from 11:30 to 13:00 (at least 0.25 ATR), and at 13:00 price is on the new side of VWAP. One signal per session, in the direction of the new VWAP slope; tested with and against.
- **vwap_tail_rejection** (VWAP, M5): A 5-minute candle whose whole body sits above VWAP, closes up, and whose lower wick reaches VWAP (within 0.05 ATR) and is at least as long as the body and 0.3 ATR leans long; the mirror below VWAP leans short. Up to two signals a session, 9:45 to 14:30.
- **vzo_extreme_reentry** (volume, M5): Each 5-minute bar's volume counts as buying on an up close and selling on a down close; the Volume Zone Oscillator is the 14-bar smoothed signed volume as a percent of smoothed volume. Between 10:30 and 14:30 the first cross back up through -40 leans long and the first cross back down through +40 leans short. One signal per session; tested with and against.
- **weis_wave_pullback** (volume, M5): Swing waves from a 1-ATR zigzag. After a thrust of at least 2 ATR, a counter-wave that retraces at most 62% of it on at most 60% of its volume is complete once price turns back 1 ATR; that bar's close, on the thrust side of VWAP, signals continuation (long after an up-thrust, short after a down-thrust). 10:00 to 14:30 ET, one signal per side per session; tested with and against.
- **climax_reversal** (wyckoff, M5): A bar with at least 3x its usual volume for that time slot and a range of at least 2 ATR that makes a new session low (high) but closes in the top (bottom) 40% of its range is a selling (buying) climax: lean long (short) on the reversal, before 15:00. One per side per session.
- **effort_no_result** (wyckoff, M5): A 5-minute bar with at least 2x its usual volume but a range under 0.6 ATR, sitting at the session low, shows selling being absorbed; a close above that bar's high within 6 bars leans long. The same bar at the session high followed by a close below its low leans short. Before 15:00.
- **hv_break_trap** (wyckoff, M5): Price closes outside the previous 12 bars' range on at least 1.5x normal volume (10:30-14:30 ET). If within the next 3 bars a bar closes back inside that range, the break is read as failed: lean against it at that close (a failed break up is a short, a failed break down is a long). One per side per session. Tested with and against.
- **no_demand_no_supply** (wyckoff, M5): A narrow-spread bar on lower volume than the two bars before it, with a wick rejecting the move (up bar with an upper wick = no demand; down bar with a lower wick = no supply). When the next bar closes the other way beyond the signal bar's close, that is the signal: short after no demand, long after no supply. Between 10:45 and 15:00 ET, one per side per session; tested with and against.
- **spring_upthrust** (wyckoff, M5): After the initial balance, a bar wicks beyond the IB low (high) and closes back inside on below-average volume for that time slot (low effort) while closing in the outer half of its own range against the wick (strong result): the effort-vs-result divergence marks a spring (lean long) or upthrust (lean short), before 15:00. One per side per session.
- **squat_bar_reversal** (wyckoff, M5): After a 6-bar leg of at least 1.5 ATR, a 5-minute bar with more volume than the one before it but less range per unit of volume (a Williams squat bar) and at least 1.5x its usual volume shows the leg meeting opposition. A close within 3 bars back through the squat bar's far side leans against the leg. Before 15:00.
- **volume_dryup_pullback** (wyckoff, M5): After six closes on one side of VWAP, a three-bar pullback against that side on steadily shrinking volume that never touches VWAP, then a bar that closes beyond the pullback's extreme in the trend direction, between 10:00 and 14:30. Tested with and against; one signal per side per session.

Filters: vwap = on the trade side of VWAP; rvol = 1.3x normal volume for the time of day; ppoc = beyond yesterday's POC in the trade direction; trend = the structure trend agrees; sma200 = daily close on the trade side of the 200-day average.
